verdict.rationale: The pack contains no training opt-out control and no policy stating that user or company data is excluded from AI model training. The statements that Ultrametric 'runs no model' and that adapter context 'stays local during retrieval' are adjacent architecture claims, not a documented way to stop data from being used for training. Hosted company records are stored server-side, and their training-use posture is not addressed anywhere.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
